name: m8_tapped_plate
description: Simple plate 60x40x10 with one centered M8 tapped through-hole and R2 rounded outer edges — internal-thread feature path; export must carry a real groove.

stages.prompt:
Rectangular mounting plate, parametric, mm units. Plate 60 long (X) x 40 wide (Y) x 10 thick (Z), resting on the XY plane, centred in X and Y.
- One M8 tapped (internal thread, M8x1.25) hole straight through the plate, centred at x=0, y=0, axis along Z. Model the hole at tap-drill size and declare the thread; the export rebuild carries the real thread groove.
- Round the four vertical outer edges, radius 2.
No other features.
